{{Quote|I suppose my tastes are pedestrian; you can take a boy out of the Mid Rim, but&hellip;|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
The '''Mid Rim''', also known as the '''Mid-Rim''', '''Middle Rim''', '''Mid-systems''', or the '''Mid Rim Territories''', was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] located between the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
With fewer natural resources&mdash;and therefore a smaller population&mdash;than many neighboring regions, the Mid Rim was a territory where residents worked hard for everything they had. Several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] built up impressive economies, and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raiders often hid in the relatively unexplored spaces far from major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]].

==Culture==
[[File:Naboo.png|thumb|left|210px|[[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a planet in the Mid Rim's [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]]]
The beings that inhabited the Mid Rim worlds were known among the galaxy as being plain, honest, hardworking, and leading simple lives; they were also stereotyped as being simple minded, and that their worlds were extremely average and regular. Mid Rimmers were patient, but were fiercely defended their families and property. This attitude had its origins in its colonization: most corporations chose to remain in the Expansion Region, while criminals chose to move further away from the Core, to the Outer Rim; the Hutts also chose to operate rimwards. Subsequently, Mid Rimmers had to cope with [[pirate/Legends|piracy]].<ref name="TEA" />

The worlds of the Mid Rim were more sparsely populated than the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and as a result its people tended to be less comfortable in dense living quarters. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] expeditionary and colonial [[Outbound Flight Project]] required its planned complement of 50,000 passengers to live in tightly packed housing with little privacy aboard the six [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] that would be joined together to form the ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. The living arrangements at the project's [[Preparation Center]] were deliberately cramped to replicate those that the expedition would provide. As a result, many people [[Homeworld/Legends|native to]] the Mid Rim dropped out of the Outbound Flight Project prior to its launch<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="OF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref>

==History==
===Beginnings===
During the [[Pre-Republic era]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were ruled by the galactic-spanning [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], who terraformed the planet's surface for agricultural purposes. The collapse of their empire left the terraforming machines unattended, which resulted in the planet's abnormally large foliage. The [[Hutt Empire]] encompassed a number of Mid Rim worlds including [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> However, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] resisted Hutt expansion and carved up their own independent region of space, which evolved into the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Mid Rim politically developed as a consequence of a colonization boom in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Profits from business ventures in the Expansion Region prompted [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was giving away land opportunities and money for development. Bureaucrats planned criss-crossing patterns of colonization along [[the Slice/Legends|the Slice]], and the beneficiaries were mainly several [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] political systems and religious organizations and only few corporations (the Expansion Region had business-friendly policies). Over the following millennia, colonization in the Mid Rim developed at a progressive albeit leisurely pace which provided successive generations of colonists with ample space to expand into. They also benefitted from low-cost manufacturing and agriculture.<ref name="TEA" />

Due to the stronger presence of central government from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], there was less criminal activity in the region than in the more distant [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The crime-dominated [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] bordered the eastern fringes of the Mid Rim, and the Hutts saw the Mid Rim as a "shield" against the Republic Core, operating alone the Outer Rim.<ref name="TEA" />

===The Galactic Republic===
Around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the factious [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] following a violent first encounter which led to the [[Aqualish–Republic War]]. Subsequently, the Aqualish joined the Republic after agreeing to abide by Republic law. In [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was settled by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonists as a Republic military outpost. Circa [[8000 BBY]], the Republic established an outpost on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], which was home to the sapient quadruped [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] species.<ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> In [[4020 BBY]], Kashyyyk was rediscovered by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], which renamed the planet G5-623 and subsequently Edean.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] the Mid Rim was known as the Frontier or Galactic Frontier, as it was the limit of the then explored galaxy. However, this prosperity attracted the attention of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who used unexplored space as a hiding place and staging ground for raids on colonies. This became a problem in the period following the [[Sith Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] considered invading Kashyyyk and using it as a training center for their troops but later abandoned such plans. Later, the Wookiee [[Chuundar]] seized power as [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] from his father [[Freyyr]] and banished his own brother [[Zaalbar]]. Chuundar actively collaborated with the Czerka Corporation by allowing them to exploit Wookiee slave labor in exchange for weapons. Freyyr went into self-exile to the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of Kashyyyk. In [[3956 BBY]], Czerka's control of "Edean" was disrupted when the enslaved Wookiee populace, led by [[Freyyr]] and the former Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], overthrew the local corporate headquarters and drove all outsiders off the planet, save from the [[Ebon Hawk]] crew.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Around [[3951 BBY]], the [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmalltian]] Queen [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] sponsored an expedition by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] explorer [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]] who discovered the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The planet became notorious amongst big game hunters who favored the indigenous [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]], although it would be five decades before permanent Human settlement. Eventually, in approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], Human refugees fleeing a violent revolution on Grizmallt settled in the mountains and great grass plains. Cultural differences between the Human colonists and the indigenous [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] led to tensions and conflict over the millennia.<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[3693 BBY]], the discovery of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] encouraged colonization in the northern and southern arcs of the region. By this time, the region was organized into structured government-zoned settlement districts, with sectors lazily named alphanumerically. Following the [[Great Galactic War]], large portions of the Mid Rim came under the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]] including loyalist worlds and species like [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:TF_Battleship.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] fleet blockade over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]]]
During the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1800 BBY]], Republic forces [[Bombardment of the Uba system|bombed]] the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] homeworld of [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]] and exterminated all life on [[Uba I]], [[Uba II|II]] and [[Uba V|V]] . This led to the near-extinction of the Ubese species who maintained an everlasting belligerence towards the Republic and the Jedi.<ref name="TEA" /> Throughout this period, [[Gap Nine]]<ref name="SWAJ7">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]]</ref> and [[Almas]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> were the sites of battles between the Republic and various Sith factions. In the [[Light and Darkness War]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] invaded Kashyyyk and [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. However, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] slaughtered many of the troopers. The Sith retaliated by invading their world and burning the homes of the Trandoshans, leading the surviving Trandoshans to save themselves from death by pledging loyalty to the Brotherhood. In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the lush world of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was the site of [[Ruusan campaign|seven epic battles]] which culminated in the destruction of the Brotherhood. Following the campaign, the Republic enacted the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] which increased the powers of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] while reducing the number of [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name="TNEC" />

Circa 1000 BBY, Malastare was colonized by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonists from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], which resulted in a bloody and violent war. Using their influence in the Senate, the Gran settled the conflict in their favor and established the colonial [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]]. The native Dugs were demilitarized and resettled on Malastere's western continent, where they were exploited by their Gran colonial masters over the millennia. Throughout the last centuries of the Republic, the Gran colonists dominated Malastare.<ref name="Gran in the Databank">{{DB|species|gran|Gran}}</ref><ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] increased taxation of Outer Rim trade routes, prompting the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to blockade and occupy Naboo. With the support of the Jedi and the Gungans, the Naboo Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] regained control of the planet during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]]. Meanwhile, Trandoshan terrorists attempted to assassinate the Wookiee senator [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] in protest of their homeworld being directly represented in the Senate by Kashyyyk. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], further tensions between the two species led to a Wookiee blockade of Trandosha, and peace talks collapsed when it was revealed that the Trandoshans were seeking to obtain representation with Trade Federation backing.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the secession of various Republic worlds into [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] created a flow of [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] refugees from Separatist worlds. The [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] organized the resettlement of these refugees on ten Mid Rim worlds including Naboo, [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]], [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]], [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] and [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]]. The Aqualish government on Ando also joined the Separatists but were opposed by the rival [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]], which remained loyal to the Republic. Due to Jedi intervention, the backwater world of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] remained within the Republic.<ref name="TNEC" /> Similarly, the Gran Protectorate on Malastare remained loyal to the Republic with its [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] serving on the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]. An organization called [[Dugs-for-Democracy]] opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] and fought for the civil rights of Dugs.<ref name="HNNV.531 55">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #55]]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], control of the Mid Rim fluctuated between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Confederacy took advantage of interspecies rivalry between the Wookiees of Kashyyyk and the Trandoshans by arming Trandoshan commercial raiders on attacks against Republic shipping. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Separatists launched their first offensive against Kashyyyk with Trandoshan support but were repulsed by Republic forces. During the [[Dark Reaper campaign]], the Chiss mercenary [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] raided a Wookiee colony on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. Due to its vital fuel reserves, Malastare was targeted by Separatist forces, who were repulsed by local Dug forces and Republic reinforcements under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who accidentally awakened the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]].<ref name="TCW:TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Separatist attempts to encourage the planets [[Junction V]], [[Bezim]], [[Delaluna]] and [[Vicondor/Legends|Vicondor]] to secede failed due to Jedi intervention. Republic forces under Anakin Skywalker also captured the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] and destroyed the Confederacy's [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|cortosis battle droid]] project. In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.9 BBY]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]]&mdash;the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]&mdash;deployed mutant [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] on the backwater world of [[Orleon]] in response to rumors of Separatist biolabs. While such rumors were later proven false, the stone mites destroyed much of the planet's infrastructure; prompting the planet's entire population to emigrate offworld.<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Separatist forces were repulsed at [[Azure/Legends|Azure]]. Towards the end of the war, most CIS forces were repulsed to the Mid and Outer Rims. Separatist forces also launched a [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|massive invasion of Kashyyyk]] in an attempt to capture the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild's]] secret archive of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes. Republic reinforcements under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] crushed the droid army, but the Jedi were then targeted for extermination under [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Under the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial forces invaded Kashyyyk and enslaved the Wookiees with the collaboration of the Trandoshans, who profited in the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

===The Empire===
[[File:TheMidRim.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the Mid Rim circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], as reorganized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]]]
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], a series of Imperial academies were established throughout the Mid Rim. It was heavily patrolled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which feared that it was ripe for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] to set up bases there, although the region remained generally loyal. In return, the region's interstellar markets also profited from favorable trading incentives.<ref name="TEA" />

As the Empire withdrew from the Rim following their [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the Mid Rim remained one of the few places unquestionably under Imperial control. After the Battle of Endor, it housed many hidden Imperial bases and makeshift [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Many rival [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] maintained "private empires" in this region on the condition that they supply troops and taxes to legitimate Imperial fleets in the region. During the time of the return of Palpatine in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Mid Rim was still a significant Imperial power base which kept their massive fleets supplied.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Palpatine's final clone body and spirit were destroyed during a [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Following his demise, the Alliance's successor state the New Republic recaptured much of the Mid Rim. By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Empire had been pushed out of the Mid Rim into eighteen backwater [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the Outer Rim known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], the Bothan capital of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] was the site of fighting between various pro- and anti-Bothan factions. With the appearance of Imperial forces, these disparate factions united to defeat a common foe. Shortly afterwards, the Imperial Remnant and the New Republic signed the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]], which ended the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEC" />

===Post-Empire===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], much of the eastern Mid Rim was invaded by the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]], mostly the Slice portion.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Battle of Ithor|Ithor was devastated]] by a Yuuzhan Vong bioweapon while New Republic and Imperial forces evacuated many refugees from Ord Mantell. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong conquered and devastated much of the region as part of their campaign to secure the strategic [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. Several worlds including [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], Falleen, Ando Prime, Rodia and Ansion were conquered and occupied. [[Battle of Kalarba|Kalarba was destroyed]] by using the [[Yo'gand's Core]] tactic to draw down its moon [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]] while Rodian captives were "[[Shaping protocol|shaped]]" into [[Vagh Rodiek]] warbeasts. The Yuuzhan Vong also invaded [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], capturing Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TNEC" /> However, they failed to penetrate the well-defended ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region. The region was also economically wrecked due to the collapse of the local economy and trade routes. A few worlds escaped invasion by aligning themselves with the collaborationist [[Peace Brigade]] only to be raided by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces during the later stages of the war.<ref name="TEA" />

With the end of the war and the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|recapture of the galactic capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], those Peace Brigade worlds were unpopular with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government&mdash;the successor state to the Republic. Rejecting foreign aid, the Mid Rimmers rebuilt their worlds and established new trade routes, which brought a post-war boom to the region. Meanwhile, the slave-trading [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]] encouraged the immigration of refugees.<ref name="TEA" /> 

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]], [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]] and [[Beris]] sided with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-led [[Confederation]] against the Galactic Alliance. Following a [[Solo-Niathal coup|coup]] by [[Darth Caedus]], Alliance forces [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] Kashyyyk for sheltering Jedi. Orbital bombardment of Kashyyyk's forests created a firestorm that engulfed much of the planetwide jungle and killed many Wookiees. In response, the Confederation redirected fleets from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to help the Wookiees which led to the repulsion of Alliance forces. Despite Confederation assistance, the Wookiees joined the [[Jedi Coalition]].<ref name="Inferno 1">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

Following the [[Sith–Imperial War]] in [[130 ABY]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] seized control of much of the Mid Rim and sought to "divide and conquer" the various worlds and species. Viewing the Wookiees as a potential threat, the Sith Empire did not enslave the entire species as their predecessors but rather isolated Kashyyyk from the rest of the galaxy by destroying all spaceports and shipyards. No Wookiees were allowed to leave or visit Kashyyyk without an Imperial order and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions to the planet were completely cut off. Supplies and traders still could come and go, after swearing under penalty of death not to provide Wookiees with information of the state of the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but the Wookiees themselves were completely isolated and largely left alone. In contrast, other species like the Trandoshans and Rodians prospered economically and militarily as "favored species." The Trandoshans prospered from the redirection of trade to their homeworld while Rodian [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] claimed more Jedi bounties than their rivals.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
